description: This file implements the QuickHull algorithm for computing convex hulls of geographic points, integrated with Leaflet marker clusters.

classes.name: L.QuickHull
classes.description: A static object providing methods to compute convex hulls using the QuickHull algorithm for geographic points.

methods.name: getDistant
methods.description: Calculates an approximate distance of a point from a baseline line.

methods.name: findMostDistantPointFromBaseLine
methods.description: Finds the point most distant from a baseline and the set of points outside the baseline.

methods.name: buildConvexHull
methods.description: Recursively builds the convex hull from a baseline and a set of points.

methods.name: getConvexHull
methods.description: Computes the convex hull of an array of latlng points.
